title: Mechanisms of transcription control by distal enhancers from single-gene nanoscopy
title_zh: 单基因纳米成像揭示远程增强子转录调控机制
abstract: Distal enhancers activate genes over vast genomic distances, but how this communication occurs and what signals are transmitted are poorly understood. Using real-time single-gene nanoscopy and targeted perturbations, we define physical parameters and mechanisms of enhancer-promoter communication. We find that productive interactions are dynamic, occur at a proximity of ≲100 nm, and are coordinated with transcriptional bursts. Enhancers and promoters find one another not only through passive diffusion; we often directly observe them being actively brought together by cohesin-mediated loop extrusion, which is a key determinant of transcriptional burst frequency. We also discover that specific general transcription factors (GTFs) of RNA polymerase II machinery are key to initiating transcriptional bursts, and enhancer-promoter interactions activate bursting by embedding the promoter within GTF clusters that form at the enhancers. Our results resolve the molecular and biochemical signals involved in long-range gene activation and elucidate the biophysical mechanisms for their transmission from the enhancer to the promoter.
abstract_zh: 远程增强子能够在广阔的基因组距离上激活基因，但其通信方式和传递的信号尚不清楚。通过实时单基因纳米成像和靶向干扰，我们定义了增强子-启动子通信的物理参数和机制。我们发现有效的相互作用是动态的，发生在≲100 nm的接近范围内，并与转录突发同步。增强子和启动子不仅通过被动扩散相互寻找；我们经常直接观察到它们被共济蛋白介导的环回挤压主动拉近，这是转录突发频率的关键决定因素。我们还发现RNA聚合酶II机器中特定的通用转录因子（GTF）是启动转录突发的关键，增强子-启动子相互作用通过将启动子嵌入在增强子处形成的GTF簇中来激活突发。我们的结果阐明了长距离基因激活所涉及的分子和生化信号，并阐明了它们从增强子传递到启动子的物理机制。
